# What the build and the tests need, and the deployed app does not.
#
# Kept out of requirements.txt on purpose. Streamlit Community Cloud installs
# that file to run the app, and a dependency with no wheel for whatever Python
# the deployment is on fails the whole build -- which would be a live app taken
# down by a package it never imports. duckdb is only reachable from
# engine/run_sql.py, which runs here and in CI.
duckdb==1.5.4

pytest==9.1.1
ruff==0.15.21

# The Power BI tests validate every generated file against the published JSON
# schema it names. Without these two they skip loudly rather than failing, so
# they are a dev dependency and not a silent one.
jsonschema==4.26.0
referencing==0.37.0

# Deliberately NOT here: scipy. `Series.corr(method="spearman")` pulls it in,
# and three recoverability tests used to pass locally on somebody else's
# transitive install and fail in CI. Spearman is Pearson on the ranks; see
# tests/test_generated_data.py::spearman.
